purpose: Teach: カルロス/奄美/インディアン/南アフリカ/カイロ/ジョニー/日産/西武

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがカルロス・ゴーン社長時代の日産を語られた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad used to talk about his time at Nissan during the Carlos Ghosn era.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Searching for a memory that feels just out of reach. Gentle, measured pace. The voice of someone realizing how much time has passed.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、奄美の親戚を訪ねられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Mm, that's right — and you visited your relatives in Amami back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, gently corrective. A little amused at the tangent. The patience of someone who knows his mind wanders. Fond, familiar tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがインディアンジュエリーを集めた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad collected Indian jewelry.
lines.style: Distant, searching tone. The memory surfaces like something half-forgotten. Slight pause between phrases. Voice trails as if he's trying to place it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、南アフリカ駐在のお話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you were stationed in South Africa — you told me that story, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gently teasing now. She knows where this is going. Warm but with an undertone of long-suffering affection. A small smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがカイロのピラミッドに憧れた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad had always dreamed of seeing the pyramids in Cairo.
lines.style: Slower now, more contemplative. The wistfulness deepens into something closer to longing. Each phrase deliberate. Voice softens on the final words.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ジョニー・キャッシュのレコードがお好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you were quite fond of Johnny Cash records yourself, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Knowing, slightly exasperated affection. She's redirecting him again with practiced ease. A hint of humor underneath — she's done this many times. Voice warm but matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが日産のディーラーで車を選ばれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad chose his first car at a Nissan dealership.
lines.style: The memory surfaces again, fainter now. Gentle, almost dreamy quality. Slower pace. Voice becomes quieter, as if speaking to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、西武百貨店の催事に通われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: That's right — and you used to visit the exhibitions at the Seibu department store quite often, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Close, intimate tone. Affectionate but tinged with knowing sadness. She's bringing him back gently. Soft trailing-off at the end, like a hand touching his arm.
